1989-01-24: Behind Todd Day's 26 points, Arkansas Razorbacks rolled past Southern Utah 109–76. Kelvin Lee had 20 for Southern Utah.
1996-12-28: Behind Ali Thompson's 16 points, Arkansas Razorbacks rolled past Southern Utah 92–52. Mark Schweigert had 22 for Southern Utah.
1999-12-11: New Mexico Lobos beat Southern Utah Thunderbirds 62–57. Damion Walker led the winners with 17 points. Frederick House had 15 for Southern Utah Thunderbirds.
